current_grouping: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information

versions.grouping_at_time: Subpart G — Operating Limitations and Information
versions.text:
The following loading information must be furnished:
(a) The weight and location of each item of equipment that can easily be removed, relocated, or replaced and that is installed when the UAV was weighed under USAR.25.
(b) Appropriate loading instructions for each possible loading condition between the maximum and minimum weights established under USAR.25, to facilitate the centre of gravity remaining within the limits established under USAR.23.
